description: List MISIM.AI guide chapters (kind='guide') for discovery. Returns the latest available tax year and all chapters in that year, with publication dates. Optionally filter by a specific tax year (e.g., 2025, 2026). Use this to surface guides in annual-return and form-1301 workflows: users can then call misim_get_document to read the full chapter. Provenance: MISIM.AI library (lc_library_public, kind=guide), verified by Melanie Abramov, CPA, 05.11.2026. רשימת הנחיות
